scripts.db:migrate: sequelize-cli --config src/config/postgresConfig.js --migrations-path src/db/migrations --models-path src/db/models --seeders-path src/db/seeders db:migrate
scripts.db:migrate:undo: sequelize-cli --config src/config/postgresConfig.js --migrations-path src/db/migrations --models-path src/db/models --seeders-path src/db/seeders db:migrate:undo
scripts.init-db: npx dotenv-cli -- bash -c 'npx sequelize-auto -h "$DB_PG_HOST" -p "$DB_PG_PORT" -d "$DB_PG_NAME" -u "$DB_PG_USER" -x "$DB_PG_PWD" -e postgres --cm p -l esm --sg true -o ./src/db/models'
